ai.headline: LinkedIn adds AI-output accuracy disclaimer and clarifies content license and payment terms
ai.summary: LinkedIn's updated User Agreement now says you are responsible for checking whether AI-generated or other content and information on its services is accurate before relying on it, and it tells you to verify it yourself. The agreement also makes clear that LinkedIn can use your content without compensation, that a secondary payment method may be charged if your primary one fails, and that LinkedIn may change prices and other terms without prior notice in some cases.
